entry.title: Proxmark 5
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 325.00

The Proxmark is the industry standard device for RFID analysis, providing multi-frequency reading, writing, emulating, demodulation, sniffing and cracking across almost any RFID system and frequency.

The Proxmark 5 is a generational upgrade over the Proxmark 3, covering both operational improvements and adding new functionality. The upgraded system core brings increased frequency range, optimised RFID performance, improved stability, faster operations.

The fully redesigned core is faster, more stable, supports more frequencies. The redesigned antennas are hot-swappable and feature dynamic power adjustment - meaning better performance in challenging conditions, further read-range and “no dead-spots”. The modular architecture allows for drop-in modules (like the wireless module), expansion via GPIO, and even pairing with the Flipper Zero.

Users can now connect two Proxmark 5 devices to perform relay attacks: one device reads the original card and transmits its data wirelessly to another device positioned on a reader, enabling a new class of RFID audit capability.

The Proxmark 5 was designed in close collaboration with the Proxmark community; all functionality and features are integrated and supported in the “iceman” firmware.

IMPORTANT ⚠️ Pre-release firmware

The Proxmark 5's firmware is pre-release / currently unstable. If you required stable, out-of-the-box functionality we advise purchasing the Proxmark 3 RDV4.01

Discover the Proxmark 5

Proxmark 5 Advantages

Eight years of community feedback, technical improvements and RFID research culminated in one device. Discover how the Proxmark 5 will improve your RFID workflow:

  • 1
  • 2
  • 3
  • 4
  • 5
  • 6
  • 7

New Architecture

Eight years of hardware improvements for unmatched RFID & system performance: RFID operations benchmarked at least 65% faster.

New Antennas

Hot-swappable, high-performance dynamic antennas for improved read range, no dead-spots and more stable coupling.

Built for mobile audits

Drop-in battery+wireless module for mobile-first audits and improved standalone capabilities.

New Pentest Functions

Two Proxmark 5 device can be paired to perform wireless relay audits: one device reads the card, the other opens the door.

Built for flexibility

Connect anything: Flipper Zero, SPI, UART, External Mass Storage via the Dual-Mode USB-C port

Built to be extended

Accessible GPIO and open-source code make development, modules and expansion easy.

Integrated Frequency Detector

Detect and identify RF fields and frequencies instantly

Functionality

The Proxmark 5 is the most advanced and complete RFID research platform available, covering high-level functions (read, write, emulate, clone), pentest and audit oriented functionality (cracking, sniffing and relay) and low-level functions (interacting with the bit-stream, demodulating raw frames, analysing protocols).

Designed, oriented and optimised towards technical users, the Proxmark device is controlled via its command-line interface (CLI) in a wired or wireless context. New users should expect a learning curve - but are supported by extensive documentation and tutorials, and welcomed by the active Discord and Github communities.

    • Low Frequency: 125kHz - 500kHz
  • Chipset: AT32F435 (288MHz)

  • ADC: 10-bit

  • Feedback

    • 1x Multi-function button

entry.title: Stealth Decoy Reader
entry.summary:
Vendor: Mayweather
Type: RFID
Price: 125.00 - 685.00 (9 variants)

THE PROBLEM

Extracting RFID & Keypad credentials via spliced implants is a well-known technique. However, these tools are rarely used in professional audits: installations are slow and complicated, and damage to wiring, hardware and infrastructure are rarely authorised in Scope of Engagement documents.

The implants themselves have limited functionality and protocol support, and only provide the "capture" part of an RFID Audit lifecycle. The analysis and cloning of a captured credential requires multiple manual steps, tools and skills.

THE SOLUTION

Imagine walking into an audit, placing an access control reader on a wall and instantly collecting credentials. Your phone gives you real-time notifications of skimmed badges and PIN codes, and directly writes a clone badge with your Proxmark.

You don't need a computer, you don't need to damage client property, you don't need to memorise arcane Proxmark commands. Everything is taken care of. When the audit is over, you've got a timestamped log of all operations, ready for export into a report. Your time and skills are spent on the audit, instead of the tools.

You've just imagined the Stealth Decoy Reader platform, a next-generation, non-destructive credential capture system designed specifically for red-teamers and pentesters. The Stealth Decoy Reader is an open-source, battle-tested hardware module built to collect and exfiltrate all known corporate access-control protocols and PIN codes.

Even better, the Stealth Decoy Reader is available pre-installed inside the most common access control readers for perfect camouflage. The readers come equipped with non-destructive mounting systems, ready for rapid placement in public areas, choke points, doorways, cabinets, etc.

Rapid deployment during public access

Credential capture

Instant notifications and credential management

One-click cloning via Proxmark 3

The Stealth Decoy Reader Platform covers the full RFID pentest life-cycle:

  1. Capture: Rapidly deployed, instant multi-factor credential skimming
  2. Control: Manage multiple devices, analyse, save, tag and exfiltrate captured credentials via the cross-platform WebUI.
  3. Clone: Emulate, clone and write captured credentials directly from the UI via Proxmark 3. One click & wireless: No command lines, no code.
  4. Access: Gain and escalate access via cloned RFID.

MULTI-PROTOCOL

Supports all corporate RFID and keypad protocols, including HID & Wiegand, iCLASS, Indala, Paxton..

UNDETECTABLE

Physical switch to deactivate WiFi for undetectable installation, NAC evasion, and reduced RF exposure.

NON-DESTRUCTIVE INSTALLATION

No need to remove readers, crimp cables or damage client hardware. Deploy and remove in seconds.

PROFESSIONAL TOOL & SUPPORT

Built by pentesters based on real-world requirements: modern hardware, software and frequent updates.

POWERED BY STEALTH

Inside every Stealth Decoy Reader is a Stealth Decoy Module - the high-performance, multi-protocol, wireless equipped RFID capture, analysis and cloning device. It works hand-in hand with the Doppelgänger Assistant, a cross-platform professional GUI application designed to handle every possible operation requirement.

Together, they allow for automated card capture and wireless credential exfiltration. Teams can collaborate and share credentials; credentials can be analysed, exported or cloned.

The Doppelgänger Assistant also works as a easy-to-use UI for the Proxmark 3, making credential writing, cloning and verification a one-click operation. Don't miss opportunities because of knowledge gaps or constrained time: the Doppelgänger Suite is a results-oriented system for complete RFID audits.

Skim RFID and matching PIN credentials simultaneously. Handles all corporate protocols, including iCLASS SE/SEOS/SR.

3. NEVER MISS A CREDENTIAL

Support for all major corporate RFID systems. Frequent firmware and software updates. Never miss a credential.

4. NO RISK, NO DAMAGE INSTALLS

No risky, lengthy or destructive installation or hardware modifications required. Deploy in seconds. Runs on internal power.

5. BUILT FOR DISCRETION

Credential capture is silent, and can trigger notifications, SMS or emails. Hardware switch to disable all RF emissions.

FIELD-READY WORKFLOW

Unlike traditional approaches for RFID audits, the Stealth Decoy Reader system provides a full end-to-end workflow for RFID audits. Frequently Asked Questions

What are the functional differences between the KIISU and Flipper?

Although this board can run almost any Flipper Zero firmware, there are a few limitations:

  • It lacks Flipper Zero secret keys, so some SubGhz rolling-code protocols and U2F may not work with official firmware.
  • Antennas performance may vary.
  • Certain schematic differences mean features like battery status rely on Aux MCU firmware.

I flashed Flipper Firmware onto the KIISU, and see "No Factory Keys Found. Secure enclosure is damaged. Some apps will not work".

Because the KIISU hardware is not produced by Flipper Labs - it doesn't have their factory keys - so the Flipper Firmware shows this notification. The "no factory keys damaged enclave" only impacts functions where Official Flipper keys are required: some SubGHZ rolling codes, and the U2F functionality. In stock KIISU firmware that notification is hidden - this notification only appears when running official Flipper firmware.

Inspired by great open-source projects: Proxmark, HydraNFC, Rubber Ducky, pwnagotchi - the Flipper Zero manages to pack serious functionality into a tiny, professionally manufactured device - and stays true to its Open Source roots.

Entirely independent, the Flipper Zero requires no external computer or hardware to function - everything is driven by the its 5-way navigation button and LCD screen. With over two years of meticulous design, prototyping and iteration, the Flipper Zero is a mature platform, ready to use out of the box, meeting the needs of professionals and enthusiasts alike.

RF Transceiver

The Flipper Zero contains a fully-controllable RF platform, based on the TI CC1101 chip, allowing for RF Signal capture, analysis and transmission.

The Flipper can also be used as a USB to SPI/UART/I2C bridge for debugging, flashing and fuzzing.

The Flipper Zero emulate HID devices (Keyboard, Ethernet, etc) over USB, allowing it to perform BadUSB / RubberDucky attacks.

Users can easily upload and deploy scripts directly from the device for task automation, pentesting and more.

entry.title: iCS Decoder for iCLASS® SE / SEOS Decoder
entry.summary:
Vendor: ICopyX
Type: RF
Price: 425.00

Introduction

Lab401 is the exclusive distributor for the iCopy-X in Europe and Oceania.

The iCS Decoder is an iCopy-X accessory that allows for the rapid decoding and cloning of iCLASS SE® / SEOS® Decoder.

Until now, cloning of iCLASS SE® and iCLASS SEOS® has been impossible. With the iCS Decoder and iCopy-X - it's as easy as cloning any standard RFID tag.

Most iCLASS® SE® & SEOS® systems still have legacy card acceptance enabled in their configuration. The iCS Decoder can decode iCLASS SEOS® IP / SE cards, and then generate an new card with legacy encoding.

For pentesters, the iCS Decoder exposes an entirely new in-scope attack surface. Likewise, LEA can use the device to make rapid clones in the field of a previously impossible badge type.

Please note:

  • The iCS Decoder will only work for target systems that are configured to accept legacy cards. This is the default configuration.
  • This technique will not work on all iCLASS SE® readers. Coverage is approximate 85%.
  • The iCS Decoder is an accessory - it requires an iCopy-X.

Device Instructions

Setup and use of the iCS Decoder is rapid and simple.

  1. Plug the iCS Decoder into the iCopy-X using the provided USB-C Cable.
    The device will be automatically recognised. If it is not recognised after 5 seconds, unplug and replug the device.
  2. Place the target iCLASS SE® / iCLASS SEOS card® on the iCS Decoder.
  3. The iCopy-X will decode the card, and display the CSN, Facility Code and Card Number.

  4. Disconnect the iCS Decoder.
  5. The iCopy-X will prompt for a iCLASS SE® compatible tag ("iCS")
  6. Place the blank card on the iCopy-X, and proceed with the write.

What's included

  • 1x iCS Decoder
  • 3x iCLASS SE® / SEOS® Compatible Blank Cards (One-Time-Write)
  • 1x USB Type-C to Type-C cable
